title: Forest fires in Namibia

geometry_qc.area_integrity_rule: 0.5 <= mapped_polygon_area/source_burned_area <= 2.0; coarse integrity gate, not an uncertainty interval

scientific_note: This compact geometry is simplified for browser display. Exposure calculations use the unsimplified mapped source footprint. Flood polygons remain reported event/affected-area context and are not interpreted as observed inundation.
